categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies I2P connection management in src/net.cpp and src/i2p.cpp
categories.rationale: Mitigates timing correlation attacks against I2P transient connections by pre-creating sessions ahead of use. Decoupling session establishment from outbound stream creation improves privacy for I2P users without listening mode, providing a clear privacy improvement that is reasonably deferrable.
